content.comment_body: I read that on the standard [product_name] analog input, a 4-20 mA sensor will only be normalized up to 800, since 4mA accounts for 200 out of 1000 units. Is the same true for [product_name] as well?

Yes, this applies to [product_name] (and [product_name] RTD) as well. The analog-to-digital converter for these analog inputs converts all signals into a 0-1000 unit scale, whether it's 0-10V, 0/4-20mA, or PT100/1000. For 4-20mA signals, the first 200 units (range 1-200) represent the initial 4 mA, and the remaining 16mA (4-20mA) use units 201 to 1000.
